title: [PC, Steam] Nier: Automata Game of The Yorha Edition $19 (60% off) @ Steam
body:
Deal: [PC, Steam] Nier: Automata Game of The Yorha Edition $19 (60% off) @ Steam

[Wonderfool] Bought this game twice lol. I really like it.
[Agret] I can't remember, was the Steam version eventually updated with the newer version they put onto the Windows store?
Edit: I looked it up and yes the Steam version got the patch eventually. Japanese devs are so unreliable at patching their games.
[HoLoFoNo] Amazing games.
Even though they're sung in gibberish, some songs on the soundtrack still hit like a truck.
[Wonderfool] The chaos language was basically an excuse for Emi Evans to flex that she understands like half a dozen languages lol.
[HerpinDerp] This is genuinely one of the best games ever made.
The score, the story, depression, 2B’s ass physics and depression.
[Valkian24] I swear, that and Replicant are the same sale prices every time.
(Already got them both on PS4 but wanna get Replicant to try out the new mod that uses the Daddy Nier model)
[VlVh] It's $16.15 at Greenmangaming if you have the xp. Nier replicant is $30.58 there too.
[dottjt] Is there an edition of this game where I don't have to play it through multiple times?
[plmko] Are you actually playing it through multiple times?
That's the question.
[jonathonsunshine] I know that you can buy the PS$ version and not even play through it once?
[aka nioh] Absolute banger of a game. Just when you think it's finished, it's only just getting started. Plot, characters, graphics, soundtrack and gameplay all outstanding
[Elegant Giant] The DLC & sequel are 60% off as well
Nier: Automata both came out (originally) after Nier and is set after it, though the remastered version ("Nier: Replicant") was released after Automata. You don't have to play Nier: Replicant in order to play Automata.
Also recommend playing Automata, is very good.
